defects.what: The 400 guess marks are tiny dots (about 1 unit) on the ruler; the winners in red are hard to tell from the crowd at 1080 and vanish at phone width, so the count is carried by the counters, not the marks
Caption 'One auction: 10 honest guesses around the truth. 5 high.' lands while the counter reads '3 of 10'; caption ahead of the count (same at 50 s: '169 of 330' under a caption about 40 auctions)
The North Slope frame shows only the winning-bids bar while the caption already gives both $900M and $370M; the second bar arrives later
The '+$2.4M A DEAL' bracket, 'AVG WIN $12.4M' label, 'YOU' tick and 'TRUE $10M' line all sit in the same 150-unit band at the top of the ruler; crowded

one_line: The forty-auctions count makes the curse mechanical rather than moral, and the numbers hold; make the winners' marks visible and it is a strong film.
